Definition: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized for war (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
BiblicalUsage: 1) that which goes forth, army, war, warfare, host; 1a) army, host; 1a1) host (of organised army); 1a2) host (of angels); 1a3) of sun, moon, and stars; 1a4) of whole creation; 1b) war, warfare, service, go out to war; 1c) service
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
